# ASSETS — provenance and licences (16:9 edition)

**Every visual and audio element in this film is original and generated by code in this
folder.** No stock footage, stock photography, third-party icons, sampled music, or sound
libraries are used. Nothing requires attribution beyond the citations for factual claims.

| Asset | Type | Origin | Generator | Licence / attribution |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Customer nodes, rings, bars, scatter, cards, arrows, timelines | Vector graphics | Drawn in React/SVG at render time | `scenes/remotion/CanAIPredictYourNextClick16x9.tsx` | Original |
| Event-type icons (envelope, window, magnifier, eye, cart, bag) | SVG icons | Hand-drawn SVG paths in the composition | same | Original |
| Person glyphs (B13 holdout schematic) | SVG | Hand-drawn in the composition | same | Original; schematic labelled ILLUSTRATIVE |
| Reliability diagram | Manim animation, 1728×1728 → PNG sequence 1408×1408 (shown in B12) + constant-fps mp4 | Data from `evaluation/calibration_bins.csv` | `scenes/manim/calibration_scene.py` → `scripts/stage_manim_clip.py` → `scenes/renders/B12_frames/` (used by the film) and `scenes/renders/B12_calibration.mp4` | Original |
| Evaluation charts (ROC, PR, calibration, confusion, importance) | PNG | Matplotlib from model outputs | `src/04_evaluate_models.py` → `evaluation/` | Original |
| Segment scatter, probability histograms | PNG | Matplotlib | `src/06_export_visualizations.py` → `assets/charts/` | Original |
| Synthetic customer data | CSV | Seeded simulation (seed 20260912) | `src/01_generate_data.py` | Original; contains no real persons |
| Synthetic customer avatars | — | Not used; customers are shown as IDs (`C02661`) and nodes | — | — |
| Narration | WAV, 24 kHz mono | Kokoro-82M `af_kore` via `kokoro-onnx`, local — identical to the 9:16 cut | `scripts/generate_narration.py` | Kokoro-82M model weights: Apache-2.0 |
| Music bed | WAV, 48 kHz stereo | Additive sine synthesis, seeded noise | `scripts/generate_music_sfx.py` → `assets/music/music_bed.wav` | Original |
| SFX (tick, pulse, whoosh, score, chime, cluster, impact, reveal) | WAV | Synthesised | same → `assets/sfx/` | Original |
| Final mix | WAV | ffmpeg side-chain ducking + loudnorm (−14 LUFS, −1.5 dBTP) | `scripts/mix_audio.py` | Original |
